## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits, such as `fix(roles): ...`
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `make check` passes
- [ ] Docs are updated when behaviour changes
- [ ] Existing roles keep working, or the change is marked breaking with `!`
